categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies `src/i2p.cpp` to update I2P SAM stream session leaseset encryption types, directly touching the I2P network integration.
categories.rationale: Updating I2P leaseset encryption types from 4,0 to 6,4 adopts post-quantum hybrid encryption (MLKEM-768) and phases out ElGamal per upstream recommendations. While valuable for network compatibility and cryptographic hygiene, reviewers note it is not urgent ("fine for v33 or v34 without rush"), making it a worthwhile but deferrable update.
